name: quick-shell
description: Human-approved quick shell MCP App for SSH-backed unblock commands

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && mkdir -p dist/bin && go build -o dist/bin/quick-shell-sftp ./cmd/quick-shell-sftp && node scripts/write-build-manifest.mjs
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development QUICK_SHELL_HTTP_TOKEN=dev-local-token concurrently "cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build --watch" "tsx watch src/server/main.ts --http"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage
scripts.smoke:stdio: npm run build && npm run smoke:stdio:built
